description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called MiniPlayer, which provides a dockable mini video player UI with inline controls for a video streaming app. It leverages Flutter's widget tree, provider pattern, and video_player package to manage video playback, display thumbnails, and controls.

classes.name: MiniPlayer
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a miniature video player at the bottom of the app, with controls for play/pause, close, and navigation to expanded view.

classes.name: _MiniBarSkeleton
classes.description: A private widget used as a placeholder/loading state in the mini player, showing poster images or loading/error indicators.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the MiniPlayer, reacting to video state provided by VideoPlayerProvider.

methods.name: _progress
methods.description: Calculates the progress of video playback as a value between 0 and 1.

methods.name: _buildPoster
methods.description: Builds the poster image widget, either from asset or network, with error and loading placeholders.
